page.title: Received catalogs
page.description: Catalogs and price lists sent by suppliers. Review each item to link it to the live catalog — nothing gets in without your review.

link.title: Link for suppliers to send their catalog
link.description: Send this link to suppliers: they enter their CNPJ, attach the catalog and, if they like, the template with items and prices.
link.off: The link is off — suppliers cannot send catalogs.
link.confirmDescription: The current link stops working. Catalogs already received stay here.
link.subject: Send your company's product catalog
link.message:
Hello!

We would like to know your company's products better. Through the link below you can send your catalog (PDF, spreadsheet…) and, if you like, the template with items and prices:
{{link}}

Thank you!

error.title: Could not load the catalogs
error.description: Check your connection and try again.

empty.title: No catalogs here
empty.description: Enable the link above and send it to suppliers.

review.pendingSupplier: This supplier's registration is still pending. Approve the registration before taking the prices into the catalog.
review.fileOnly: The supplier sent only the catalog file, without the item spreadsheet. Open the file and register the products you need through the catalog.
review.hint: Items with a suggested product come pre-selected. Check them and click Apply.
review.rejectDescription: Pending items are marked as ignored. The supplier can send another catalog through the link.
review.notFoundDescription: It may have been removed or the address is wrong.

createProduct.title: Create catalog product
createProduct.description: The new product enters the live catalog with this supplier as the main one and the catalog price in its history.
createProduct.name: Product name

toast.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select and copy it manually.
